title: European Accessibility Act (EU)
description: Preselected for e-commerce and financial services: keep it when the organization provides e-commerce or consumer banking services to consumers in the EU and is not a micro-enterprise (Directive (EU) 2019/882, Art. 2(2) and 4(5)).

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2019/882 on the accessibility requirements for products and services (European Accessibility Act)
